A '''[[Tree/Legends|tree]]-like creature''' next to a river on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] used its long [[tongue/Legends|tongue]] to capture and eat a flying [[Unidentified flying insectoid Endorian creature|insect]], and it smiled widely as it devoured its prey. The tree's eyes and mouth resembled seashells, and it had several more shell-like grows around its main trunk area, although it otherwise resembled a regular tree.<ref name="1-08" />
